## Ctx.handleSessionCaptionVideo() method

Optional `handleSessionCaptionVideo` route handler declaration.

**Signature:**

```typescript
handleSessionCaptionVideo?(): Promise<unknown>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;unknown&gt;

## Remarks

Executed on `video` updates while the session is active. Routing id=1 (session) runs BEFORE static/intent matching (id=2-3): it reads `ctx.getSession().method` — set via [Ctx.setSessionCaptionVideo()](./gramstax.ctx.setsessioncaptionvideo.md) which wires [Ctx.methodSessionCaptionVideo()](./gramstax.ctx.methodsessioncaptionvideo.md) — and dispatches this handler through `new Page(ctx)`<!-- -->. When no session is active, the same update falls through to the non-session route [Ctx.handleCaptionVideo()](./gramstax.ctx.handlecaptionvideo.md) instead.
